title: Concept: URL fragment written into innerHTML
description: Script that writes the URL fragment into innerHTML in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The fragment is fully attacker-controlled and never sent to the server, so a crafted link executes script in the page without any server-side filter seeing it.
applicability: Deployments that render script that writes the URL fragment into innerHTML into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The fragment is fully attacker-controlled and never sent to the server, so a crafted link executes script in the page without any server-side filter seeing it.
